// src/shop/api.smoke.bynk
// Generated by `bynk test --smoke` from the routes of `shop.api`.
suite shop.api as system {
  case "smoke: api GET /ping answers" {
    let r <- api.GET("/ping") by Visitor
    expect !(r is ServerError(_) || r is NotImplemented(_) || r is BadGateway(_) || r is ServiceUnavailable(_) || r is GatewayTimeout(_))
  }
  case "smoke: api POST /items answers" {
    let r <- api.POST("/items", Val[Item]) by User(Val[UserId])
    expect !(r is ServerError(_) || r is NotImplemented(_) || r is BadGateway(_) || r is ServiceUnavailable(_) || r is GatewayTimeout(_))
  }
  case "smoke: api POST /items rejects a malformed body" {
    let r <- api.POST("/items", Wire("{not json")) by User(Val[UserId])
    expect r is Rejected(_) || r is Handled(BadRequest(_))
  }
  case "smoke: api POST /items refuses no credential" {
    let r <- api.POST("/items", Val[Item]) by Nobody
    expect r is Rejected(Unauthorized)
  }
  case "smoke: api PUT /cart/:sku answers" {
    let r <- api.PUT("/cart/:sku", "a", Val[Item]) by User(Val[UserId])
    expect !(r is ServerError(_) || r is NotImplemented(_) || r is BadGateway(_) || r is ServiceUnavailable(_) || r is GatewayTimeout(_))
  }
  case "smoke: api PUT /cart/:sku rejects a malformed body" {
    let r <- api.PUT("/cart/:sku", "a", Wire("{not json")) by User(Val[UserId])
    expect r is Rejected(_) || r is Handled(BadRequest(_))
  }
  case "smoke: api PUT /cart/:sku refuses no credential" {
    let r <- api.PUT("/cart/:sku", "a", Val[Item]) by Nobody
    expect r is Rejected(Unauthorized)
  }
  case "smoke: api PATCH /cart/:sku answers" {
    let r <- api.PATCH("/cart/:sku", "a") by User(Val[UserId])
    expect !(r is ServerError(_) || r is NotImplemented(_) || r is BadGateway(_) || r is ServiceUnavailable(_) || r is GatewayTimeout(_))
  }
  case "smoke: api PATCH /cart/:sku refuses no credential" {
    let r <- api.PATCH("/cart/:sku", "a") by Nobody
    expect r is Rejected(Unauthorized)
  }
  case "smoke: api DELETE /cart/:sku answers" {
    let r <- api.DELETE("/cart/:sku", "a") by User(Val[UserId])
    expect !(r is ServerError(_) || r is NotImplemented(_) || r is BadGateway(_) || r is ServiceUnavailable(_) || r is GatewayTimeout(_))
  }
  case "smoke: api DELETE /cart/:sku refuses no credential" {
    let r <- api.DELETE("/cart/:sku", "a") by Nobody
    expect r is Rejected(Unauthorized)
  }
  case "smoke: admin GET /stats answers" {
    let r <- admin.GET("/stats") by User(Val[UserId])
    expect !(r is ServerError(_) || r is NotImplemented(_) || r is BadGateway(_) || r is ServiceUnavailable(_) || r is GatewayTimeout(_))
